# Rajmudra

> Rajmudra Studios is a Nagpur-based digital partner that builds and grows businesses online: websites, web apps, SEO, digital marketing, ads and social, on self-hosted systems you own rather than rented SaaS platforms.

Based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. Serving clients across India and worldwide.
Contact: hello@rajmudramedia.com
Sitemap: https://rajmudramedia.com/sitemap.xml

## Services
- [Digital Marketing Company in Nagpur (paid ads focus)](https://rajmudramedia.com/digital-marketing-company-in-nagpur): ROI-focused paid ads, SEO, social and content.
- [SEO Company in Nagpur](https://rajmudramedia.com/seo-company-in-nagpur): Local SEO, technical SEO, content and AI-search (AEO) visibility, with a free instant audit.
- [Web Development Company in Nagpur](https://rajmudramedia.com/web-development-company-in-nagpur): Fast, SEO-ready websites and web applications built on a fixed price.
- [Website Design Company in Nagpur](https://rajmudramedia.com/website-design-company-in-nagpur): Conversion-focused website design.
- [Web App Development Company in Nagpur](https://rajmudramedia.com/web-app-development-company-in-nagpur): Custom web applications.
- [Shopify Development Company in Nagpur](https://rajmudramedia.com/shopify-development-company-in-nagpur): Shopify store design, build and optimisation.
- [Social Media Marketing Company in Nagpur](https://rajmudramedia.com/social-media-marketing-company-in-nagpur): Social media strategy, content and management.
- [Restaurant Marketing](https://rajmudramedia.com/restaurant-marketing): Marketing for restaurants and cafes.
- [30 Days, 30 Websites](https://rajmudramedia.com/30-days-30-websites): A challenge to build 30 websites in 30 days on a pay-what-you-want basis, including ₹0.

## Products
- [Meeticulous](https://rajmudramedia.com/products/meeticulous): An India-first appointment booking and scheduling platform Rajmudra designed and built. 24/7 booking pages, UPI and Razorpay payments, two-way Google Calendar sync, WhatsApp and email reminders, GST invoicing, and a business dashboard. Live at https://meeticulous.com.
- [Alluminaty](https://rajmudramedia.com/products/alluminaty): Alumni management software for schools, colleges and universities: a verified alumni database and directory the institution owns, batch and house groups, events with paid registration, Razorpay membership fees, fundraising with receipts, and an admin console.
- [The Parliament](https://rajmudramedia.com/products/the-parliament): An online community platform for communities that outgrew WhatsApp groups: feed, groups, events with paid registration, paid memberships via Razorpay, DMs, video calls, moderation and WhatsApp broadcasts.
- [EZShop](https://rajmudramedia.com/products/ezshop): An online store builder for Indian D2C brands and local shops: Razorpay UPI, cards and Cash on Delivery, GST invoices, Shiprocket shipping, and WhatsApp order updates, with no commission on orders.
- [Ticket Dino](https://rajmudramedia.com/products/ticket-dino): An event ticketing and management platform for organizers, covering ticket sales, attendee management and analytics. Launching soon.
- [Coffee & Toffee](https://rajmudramedia.com/coffee-and-toffee): A Buy Me a Coffee alternative for India: creators accept tips and memberships by UPI, cards and net banking with 0% platform fee on tips, payouts to their bank via Razorpay Route, plus an own-site licence for a single creator.

## Academy
- [Rajmudra Digital Marketing Academy](https://rajmudramedia.com/academy): Project-based digital marketing learning for college students, fresh graduates and beginners. Learn, Execute, Measure, Prove. Rajmudra certificate on completion, help completing Google, Meta, HubSpot and LinkedIn online certifications, and internships in-house at Rajmudra and its sister companies. First cohorts in planning; not yet open for enrollment.
- [Programs](https://rajmudramedia.com/academy/programs): SEO, Content and Social Media Marketing, and AI for Digital Marketing first; Performance Marketing and Analytics and Growth Marketing later.
- [Practical projects](https://rajmudramedia.com/academy/projects): Sample assignments (SEO audit, content cluster, 30-day content calendar, landing-page plan, AI workflow, campaign analysis). Sample briefs, not client work.
- [Academy FAQ](https://rajmudramedia.com/academy/faq): Enrollment status, fees, format, certificates, internships and data use.
